prompt: Here's an ad-click aggregator service: a Kafka consumer reads click events off an `ad-clicks` topic and keeps a running per-ad count in memory, while an HTTP API lets you POST new clicks and GET the current counts. Every time we restart the consumer, the counts balloon — clicks that were already counted get counted all over again from the very beginning of the topic. Walk through this code, find why a restart replays the whole log and double-counts, and tell me how you'd fix it.
